prose: In the 2011 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the United Democratic Front (UDF) emerged largest with 72 seats, against 68 for the LDF. Turnout was 75.26% of 23,208,138 electors.
By vote share, the UDF polled 46.43% and the LDF 44.19%, with the NDA on 6.05%. A total of 971 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 2006, the UDF gained 26 seats (from 46 to 72); the LDF moved from 94 to 68. Power changed hands from the LDF.
The closest contest was Piravom, won by T. M. Jacob (KCA) over M. J. Jacob (CPIM) by just 157 votes. The largest margin was P. Ubaidulla in Malappuram (44,508 votes).
Oommen Chandy headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
